prompts.spring:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: seasonal background illustration behind an existing anime character on a Japanese fantasy ranch game homepage.
Primary request: Create ONE spring landscape, widescreen 1536x1024 landscape illustration with a composition that can crop to a 2.1:1 desktop banner or centered tall mobile view.
Scene/backdrop: A peaceful rural fantasy ranch viewed at eye level from the edge of a pasture: a small warm cream plaster and timber stable with a reddish brown sloping tiled roof in the left third of the midground, white wooden paddock fences leading from the lower left towards the stable, a gentle curving dirt lane beginning at lower center and receding towards center-left, layered green hills and distant pale blue mountains. Mature deciduous trees frame both outer edges; the left trees are cherry blossom trees in soft pink bloom. Fresh pale green grass, subtle tiny spring wildflowers, a few drifting petals.
Style/medium: Hand-painted anime game background, delicate painterly detail, softly drawn edges, beautiful natural depth, lightly watercolor-textured surfaces; matches a softly shaded anime girl with pink hair and a white robe, refined cozy pastoral mood.
Composition/framing: One coherent full-bleed landscape, horizon near upper middle. Stable and important scenery left of center, central view remains appealing when sides are cropped. Right third is calm open meadow and sky so a character overlaid there has a clear silhouette. Lower quarter can be hidden by a dialogue panel. No foreground focal object.
Lighting/mood: gentle warm morning daylight, airy pastel atmosphere.
Constraints: Background ONLY, no people, no characters, no creatures or animals, no text, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no frame, no collage or four-panel layout. Fully opaque.
prompts.summer:

Asset type: seasonal homepage background for a cozy Japanese fantasy ranch game.
Input images: Image 1 is the edit target, the spring version of this same ranch.
Primary request: Change ONLY the season to summer: replace all cherry blossoms and petals with rich green foliage, lush vivid green pasture, a few small summer wildflowers, clear saturated blue sky with fluffy summer cumulus clouds. Warm bright summer daylight, cheerful but gentle. No pink cherry blossoms remain.
Constraints/invariants: Preserve the exact scene, camera, dimensions, composition, architecture, stable position and details, fences, winding path, lake, hills and mountain shapes. No people, no characters, no animals, no text, no logos, no watermark, no UI, no collage, no panels. Deliver ONE image.
